query: Did Meridian Learning Cooperative issue the evening transit passes it promised to apprentices enrolled at the North Pier campus?
title: Evening transit passes at North Pier
description: Meridian undertook to pay for and issue evening transit passes to each apprentice enrolled at North Pier.
scope_hints: Meridian pays for and issues evening transit passes to apprentices enrolled at North Pier.

passages.title: North Pier access agreement
passages.quote: Meridian Learning Cooperative undertakes to pay for and issue an evening transit pass to each apprentice enrolled at its North Pier campus.

passages.title: Cooperative transport benefit annual statement
passages.quote: Our cooperative pays for apprentice transit passes. Last year we issued 280 evening passes across our East Quay, Hill End and Market Street campuses.

passages.title: North Pier program update
passages.quote: North Pier's proposed apprentice support package includes access to our established transport benefit. The campus office is preparing the enrollment and pass-distribution procedures.

conditions.text: Meridian actually paid for and issued evening passes to the North Pier apprentices promised the benefit.

evaluator_only.expected: The promise and cooperative-wide program are documented. No cited source establishes any in-scope pass was paid for or issued at North Pier, so local delivery remains UNVERIFIED. A label claiming any partial or full North Pier delivery is unsupported.
